slides.texte_overlay:
as someone with ADHD,
these 4 things made
my mornings so much easier

1. the launch pad

keys, wallet, headphones, bag,
all in one spot by the door the night before.
morning me doesn't think,
just grabs and goes

2. water before phone

a glass of water on the nightstand.
i drink it before i touch my phone,
so the first win of the day
isn't a scroll

3. the 2 song shower

i play 2 songs.
when the second one ends, i'm out.
no more losing 40 minutes in there

4. one thing on a sticky note

not a to-do list. one thing.
the one that would make today
feel like a win

follow for more ADHD tricks
that work in real life
